firstRun.title: INITIAL SYSTEM CONFIGURATION
firstRun.welcomeText: Your desktop combines hardware monitoring, configurable panels, multi-monitor layouts and a powerful Theme Studio. This guide helps you get started.
firstRun.languageText: Select your preferred interface language. You can change it later.
firstRun.monitorsText: Detected displays and their resolutions. You can adjust each display in Settings later.
firstRun.themeText: Select the starting appearance for your eDEX desktop.
firstRun.featuresText: Choose optional features. Nothing extra is installed automatically.
firstRun.finishText: Review the choices below. Changes are saved only when you finish.
firstRun.windows: Set up Windows styling later (requires Windhawk)
firstRun.introTitle: Your eDEX desktop at a glance
firstRun.introPanels: Panels: open and configure hardware information, clock and system widgets.
firstRun.introThemes: Theme Studio: edit colors, fonts, panels and preview themes.
firstRun.introDisplays: Displays: configure multi-monitor layouts and scaling in Settings.
firstRun.introWindows: Windows styling: optional; requires separate setup and approval.
firstRun.note: You can reopen this guide from Settings → General.
panelTour.heading: Panel introduction
panelTour.auto: Show introduction when adding this panel for the first time
panelTour.title: Panel guide
panelTour.body1: This is your panel. You can move or resize it within its assigned zone.
panelTour.body2: The scaling zone is the central workspace. Its boundaries are configurable under Settings → Grid & Layout.
panelTour.body3: The edge zone is outside the central scaling zone. It is useful for panels along the screen edges. Placement needs sufficient space.
panelTour.body4: Open the menu on this panel, select Setup, then choose Positioning zone: Scaling zone or Edge zone. Save to apply.
panelTour.unavailable: This panel is not currently visible. The explanation is still available.
panelGuide.common.panel.title: Your new panel
panelGuide.common.panel.body: Move or resize the panel within its positioning zone.
panelGuide.common.scale.title: Scaling zone
panelGuide.common.scale.body: The central workspace. Configure its boundaries in Settings → Grid & Layout.
panelGuide.common.edge.title: Edge zone
panelGuide.common.edge.body: The outer area beside the scaling zone. Panels can be positioned along the edges if space allows.
panelGuide.common.menu.title: Panel setup and zone assignment
panelGuide.common.menu.body: Open the panel menu → Setup → Positioning zone to choose Scaling zone or Edge zone, then save.
panelGuide.section.title: Help & introduction
panelGuide.auto: Show this panel introduction on first use
panelGuide.commonAuto: Zone basics are shown only once across all panel types.
panelGuide.clock.time.title: Time and date
panelGuide.clock.format.title: Clock options
panelGuide.clock.format.body: Choose a digital or analogue clock and customize its display in Setup
panelGuide.coderain.rain.title: Code animation
panelGuide.coderain.tuning.title: Animation settings
panelGuide.coderain.tuning.body: Code Rain is a visual effect. Adjust its supported speed and font controls in Settings ? Extensions.
panelGuide.cpu.usage.title: Processor activity
panelGuide.cpu.usage.body: Monitor the CPU load and live activity
panelGuide.cpu.details.title: Processor information
panelGuide.cpu.details.body: Use this panel to keep an eye on your CPU
panelGuide.ram.usage.title: Memory activity
panelGuide.ram.usage.body: Track memory consumption at a glance
panelGuide.ram.modes.title: Memory view
panelGuide.ram.modes.body: Choose used, free, cached, available or total in Setup
panelGuide.toplist.processes.title: Running processes
panelGuide.toplist.processes.body: See active processes and their load
panelGuide.toplist.overview.title: Process overview
panelGuide.toplist.overview.body: Compare process names and resource values to spot the busiest entries; this panel does not terminate processes.
panelGuide.globe.globe.title: World view
panelGuide.globe.globe.body: The globe visualizes geographic/network information supplied to this panel; it is a display, not a map editor.
panelGuide.globe.interaction.title: Globe interaction
panelGuide.globe.interaction.body: Use the panel controls to adjust the globe view. Dragging or clicking the visualization does not change Windows settings.
panelGuide.conninfo.traffic.title: Network activity
panelGuide.conninfo.traffic.body: Monitor network traffic and connection information
panelGuide.conninfo.readings.title: Network readings
panelGuide.conninfo.readings.body: Compare the live receive/send rates with the connection details shown by the panel.
panelGuide.calendar.dates.title: Calendar overview
panelGuide.calendar.dates.body: Use the left and right arrows to browse months; the highlighted day marks today.
panelGuide.calendar.schedule.title: Calendar usage
panelGuide.calendar.schedule.body: The calendar provides date context only; it does not import events or reminders.
panelGuide.drives.storage.title: Local drives
panelGuide.drives.capacity.title: Storage capacity
panelGuide.drives.capacity.body: Read free and used capacity per mounted drive; unavailable or removable drives may report no data.
panelGuide.filesearch.search.title: Quick file search
panelGuide.filesearch.search.body: Find files through the integrated search
panelGuide.filesearch.font.title: Readability
panelGuide.filesearch.font.body: Adjust the file-search font size in Setup
panelGuide.terminal.shell.title: Terminal input
panelGuide.terminal.shell.body: Type commands in the terminal input and use the grid selector to choose a 1?1 or 2?2 terminal layout.
panelGuide.terminal.appearance.title: Terminal appearance
panelGuide.terminal.appearance.body: Terminal font, cursor and colors are part of the active eDEX theme and can be previewed in Theme Studio.
panelGuide.weather.forecast.title: Weather information
panelGuide.weather.forecast.body: Display weather information for a selected location
panelGuide.weather.location.title: Weather location
panelGuide.weather.location.body: Choose a preset location or enter your own in Setup
panelGuide.hwinfo.hardware.title: Hardware readings
panelGuide.hwinfo.hardware.body: Review available sensor and performance readings
panelGuide.hwinfo.sensors.title: Sensor availability
panelGuide.hwinfo.sensors.body: Sensor availability depends on the hardware monitor component and supported devices; missing readings are not necessarily an error.
panelGuide.cockpit.dashboard.title: Cockpit overview
panelGuide.cockpit.dashboard.body: A consolidated dashboard of system information
panelGuide.cockpit.layout.title: Cockpit controls
panelGuide.cockpit.layout.body: Read each instrument and use its labeled controls; the cockpit is a visualization and does not tune hardware.
panelGuide.cassette.player.title: Cassette interface
panelGuide.cassette.controls.title: Audio controls
panelGuide.cassette.controls.body: Use the cassette controls to interact with the local player UI; no track is loaded automatically by this guide.
panelGuide.ddj.mixing.title: DDJ interface
panelGuide.ddj.controls.title: Deck controls
panelGuide.ddj.controls.body: The deck exposes transport, jog, knob and fader controls for its built-in demo interface.
panelGuide.cpuRail.rail.title: CPU rail
panelGuide.cpuRail.effects.title: Visual effects
panelGuide.cpuRail.effects.body: This module visualizes CPU power behavior; available styling is separate from changing processor power settings.
panelGuide.calculator.calculate.title: Calculator
panelGuide.calculator.calculate.body: Enter an expression with the keypad; the display shows the current calculation without running a system command.
panelGuide.calculator.operations.title: Operations
panelGuide.calculator.operations.body: Use the visible arithmetic controls to complete a calculation, then clear the display to start again.
panelGuide.autostart.startup.title: Startup entries
panelGuide.autostart.startup.body: This list reports applications configured to start with Windows. It only displays entries; it does not change them.
panelGuide.autostart.management.title: Startup overview
panelGuide.autostart.management.body: Use the refresh button to reload the list. Review entries here before changing startup behavior in Windows.
panelGuide.log.events.title: Event log
panelGuide.log.details.title: Troubleshooting
panelGuide.log.details.body: Use the entries to help investigate problems
panelGuide.taskdock.tasks.title: Task panel
panelGuide.taskdock.tasks.body: The task panel shows Windows task shortcuts. Select a shortcut to open its app; this does not change the Windows taskbar.
panelGuide.taskdock.tiles.title: Tile preferences
panelGuide.taskdock.tiles.body: Choose compact, standard or large tiles. The setting affects eDEX task shortcuts only.
panelTour.practice.label: Try this setting
panelTour.practice.unsaved: Preview only. Nothing is saved until you select Apply.
panelTour.practice.error: Could not save the setting. You can discard it or try again.
panelTour.practice.livePreview: Temporary live preview. Apply saves this setting; Discard restores it.
panelGuide.common.font.title: Panel text size
panelGuide.common.font.body: Try a smaller or larger panel font. The preview is temporary; choose Apply only if you want to save it.
panelTour.move.instruction: Try dragging the panel by its title bar. The guide will keep your place; you can continue whenever you are ready.
panelTour.move.success: Panel moved. Continue when you are ready.
panelGuide.clock.date.title: Show the date
panelGuide.clock.date.body: Try turning the date on or off. Apply saves the choice; Discard restores the current setting.
panelGuide.taskdock.labels.title: Shortcut labels
panelGuide.taskdock.labels.body: Toggle the names below task shortcuts to see how labels affect the task panel.
settings.tours.confirmReset: Reset completion and automatic-display settings for all tours?
settings.tours.resetDone: Tour progress reset. Choose any guide above to start it again.
settings.tours.unavailable: This guide cannot start right now.
studio.tour.title: Theme Studio guide
studio.tour.themeLibrary.title: Theme library
studio.tour.themeLibrary.body: Choose an existing theme or create a new draft. Saving and activating are separate actions.
studio.tour.themeColors.title: eDEX colors
studio.tour.themeColors.body: Edit the accent and supporting colors. The preview is local to the draft until you save and activate it.
studio.tour.themePanels.title: Panel design
studio.tour.themePanels.body: Choose the panel frame style and fonts stored in the theme. These do not modify native Windows windows.
studio.tour.themePreview.title: Preview before activation
studio.tour.themePreview.body: Preview, compare or reset the draft. Activate only after saving the selected theme.
studio.tour.windowsFeatures.title: Individual Windows settings
studio.tour.windowsFeatures.body: Each supported Windows switch can be tested independently. Use its restore action to roll back the managed value.
studio.tour.windowsStatus.title: Windhawk runtime status
studio.tour.windowsStatus.body: eDEX detects Windhawk but never installs or updates it automatically. Use the official link only when you choose to set it up.
studio.tour.windowsMods.title: Pilot mods
studio.tour.windowsMods.body: Review the official File Explorer Styler and Taskbar Styler pages. Mod installation, takeover and activation always remain explicit user actions.
studio.tour.windowsRestore.title: Recovery and change log
studio.tour.windowsRestore.body: Review backups and the activity log here. Emergency restore only applies to Windows values managed by eDEX.
